_about: Projects with a known site, for the satellite-image card. Kept by hand: the queue lists only give the connection station. 'match' picks the queue project (grid, name and applicant, compared without case or accents). 'parcels' are the land parcels (TERYT ids, as in GUNB's register of building permits) that etl/imagery.py outlines and centres the images on, through GUGiK's parcel service; 'lat'/'lon' are used only for a site without parcels. 'half_m' is half the side of the image square in metres (default: fitted to the parcels).
